title: Telenow app manifest
description: telenow.app.json — describes a Telenow app's data, tools, UI, and events. Run `telenow validate` for semantic checks the editor can't do.

id.description: Unique app id (becomes a storage key segment). Letters, digits, '.', '-', '_' only.

version.description: App version. Use semantic versioning (e.g. 1.2.0) — the platform advances the marketplace channel forward only.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog + sidebar.

runtime.description: declarative = no app code (object CRUD rules); sandboxed = JS tool handlers in the hardened runtime; external = your own backend via http handlers. Absent ⇒ declarative.

blurb.description: One-line tagline for the catalog card.

icon.description: Whitelisted sidebar/catalog icon name (resolved by the dashboard icon registry), e.g. 'boxes', 'sticky-note'.

base_url.description: For external apps: base URL of your service that `http` tool handlers are called against. Required if any tool handler.kind is 'http'.

scopes.description: Permissions consented at install (frozen — a later version that adds scopes requires re-consent). Known scopes: 'user:profile' (name+email), 'session:token' (mint a signed identity token for your backend), 'agents:read', 'calls:read', 'calls:initiate', 'whatsapp:send', 'softphone:dial', 'objects:<type>' (data access), 'http:<host>' (allow the proxy to call that host, supports a leading wildcard e.g. 'http:*.googleapis.com'), 'connection:<provider>' (inject a stored credential).

objects.description: Declarative data types stored in the shared object store.

type.description: Object type id, unique within the app.
Advisory field type (the store is schemaless; used for UI hints + indexing).

index.description: Index this field for query/upsert match. Note: object-store field indexes are shared platform-wide — index only fields you filter on.

values.description: Allowed values for a select field.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments.

kind.description: object.* = declarative CRUD on a declared object; http = call your base_url; js/sandbox = run handler code in the hardened runtime.

object.description: For object.* handlers: the declared object type to act on.

match.description: For object.update/object.delete: a declared field used to locate the record.

path.description: For http handlers: path appended to base_url.

code.description: For js/sandbox handlers: inline JS function body.

codeFile.description: For js/sandbox handlers: path to a JS file (relative to the manifest), bundled at build.

entry.description: React entry. Source path during dev (e.g. 'ui/index.tsx'); `telenow build` compiles it to 'ui/index.js'. Required when pages are declared.

styles.description: Optional stylesheet path emitted alongside the bundle.

id.description: Stable, unique-within-app page id (route segment + handed to the app).

menu.description: Show as a sidebar item (false ⇒ reachable in-app only).

events.description: Declarative event subscriptions: when `on` fires, run `handler`.

on.description: Event topic to subscribe to. One of: call.started, call.ended, call.analyzed, recording.ready, or object.<type>.created (e.g. object.patient.created, or the object.*.created wildcard).

object.description: Declared object type the handler writes (must exist in `objects`).

schedules.description: Scheduled jobs: run a handler on a fixed interval (e.g. nightly sweeps). Not a full cron — `every` is a simple duration.

key.description: Stable id, unique within the app.

kind.description: webhook (ping your backend, usual for cron) or rule (declarative upsert).

settings.description: Per-install configuration fields, rendered as an admin form. Non-secret values reach the app UI/tools; `secret` values are encrypted and injected server-side only.

type.description: Absent ⇒ text. 'secret' is encrypted at rest + injected server-side only.

secret.description: Encrypt this value; never expose it to the app UI.

default.description: Default value (not allowed for secret fields).

readme.description: Usually bundled from README.md by the CLI; you don't normally set this by hand.

changelog.description: Usually bundled from CHANGELOG.md by the CLI.

file.description: Package-relative image path (rewritten to a stored url at publish).
